summary: Provides scene-wide environment lighting from an HDR-style texture or color, where object orientation and the environment map orientation influence lighting but object position does not.

key_params.name: envlightmap
key_params.note: Sphere, equirectangular, or cube-map texture used for environment lighting/reflection

key_params.name: envlightmapquality
key_params.note: Sample quality multiplier for environment lighting

key_params.name: envlightmapprefilter
key_params.note: Controls automatic or manual pre-filtering of the environment map

key_params.name: envlightspecmap
key_params.note: Pre-filtered specular map from PreFilter Map TOP

key_params.name: material
key_params.note: Material for geometry inside the component

key_params.name: render
key_params.note: Render visibility with the Render flag

key_params.name: lightmask
key_params.note: Subset of Render TOP lights used by geometry

key_concepts: Environment Light COMP provides image-based scene lighting from outside the objects rather than from a specific point in space.
Object orientation and environment-map rotation affect which parts of the map light each side of a surface, while object position does not.
Environment Map accepts sphere, equirectangular, or cube-map style sources and adds reflection-like contribution to normal lighting.
Environment Map Quality and PBR MAT environment-light quality multiply together to control sample quality.
Automatic pre-filtering improves render quality but can be expensive for animated or frequently changing environment maps.
common_gotchas: Environment Light has no point position; moving objects in space does not change how the light hits them.
Object orientation and environment-map rotation matter because different sides sample different parts of the map.
Environment map contribution is added to normal lighting, so reduce material diffuse/specular when using it for pure reflection looks.
Automatic pre-filtering gives better quality but can be expensive for animated or frequently changing maps.
Sphere maps, equirectangular maps, and cube maps have different setup expectations; choose the correct TOP source format.
The light still needs to be included in the Render TOP lighting setup to affect the rendered scene.
